name: The Touch of Zanzil
label: Quest
description: The Touch of Zanzil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It appears as if you've brought back more information than even I expected. This certainly is a strange turn of events, friend.
A cure? Hrm... Go down to the cellar and speak with Doc Mixilpixil - he may be able to help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's about time! Just put the cheese on the table and skedaddle. Osborne will pay you on the way out.
